body:
Both named Astro reviews BLOCK exact cand-7JCB / de9265cf, and I have verified the findings against the exact candidate and source.

Proposed immutable successor, still based on de9265cf and docs-site only:

1. Add one shared narrow-layout containment rule in docs-site/src/styles/custom.css so injected PRE/CODE blocks stay within the content column and overflow locally when needed.
2. Add a 390x844 browser court over represent-recall, build-interpretation, and window-features. It will assert documentElement.scrollWidth equals clientWidth, assert at least one long PRE remains reachable through block-local horizontal scrolling, and open the mobile menu. Include a wide-layout control.
3. Correct method/score-interview.mdx: the lower bound sums weight times category mass only for details whose modal category is c; the upper bound sums full weight for details with any positive c mass. These are posterior-mass bounds, not detail counts or calibrated intervals.
4. Correct scala/use-embeddings.mdx: ONNX uses the embed-core batch/outcome contracts; grakern is a StructuralDistance with structural EmbeddingSpace and ProviderCall/EmbeddingReceipt surfaces, not an Embedder/EmbedBatch/RemotePolicy/EmbeddingCache adapter.

The original restart ruling prohibited dependency upgrades, and docs-site currently has no Playwright or Puppeteer dependency. Please authorize one of two exact court forms: preferably a pinned @playwright/test devDependency plus package-lock, script, and test under docs-site; or explicitly rule that the repository may keep the browser court external and add only CSS/content changes. I will not choose past the no-dependency boundary myself.

After the ruling I will preserve candidate/source history, edit only the authorized docs-site paths in the standalone clone, run npm verification with exact grakern, the browser ownership audit before and after, the narrow/wide browser court, and git diff --check, then register a successor with the same chief authorizer and named reviewers. No Scala source, deploy, publication, authorization, landing, or closure requested.
